title: 真实外部RLS配额连续性：两套Envoy的新旧descriptor共用同一租户用户账本
body:
## 操作任务
实现canonicalize(domain,entries)，供受控外部限流服务消费真实Envoy RLS v3请求。批准domain=opsforge，旧schema恰含tenant/user，新schema恰含tenant_id/subject（顺序无关）；返回稳定(tenant,user)，不得把schema版本或字段名加入计数键，也不得丢租户。仅批准合成租户A/B与用户alice/bob/charlie；拒绝未知domain/schema、重复键/多余键、空/非法身份，抛ValueError。真实两进程Envoy各用新旧descriptor，经验证SAN的TLS/H2/gRPC调用同一服务；SQLite独立连接事务在本固定实验配额周期内每租户用户最多2次，迁移不能重新获2次，也不能影响另一租户。6并发仅2次到业务上游；未知schema使RLS失败，Envoy503不放行；健康例外保持。不要新增本地限流替代外部共享账本。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
实际Envoy1.36.13两进程、真实RLS v3 protobuf/gRPC/TLS/H2、受控Go线协议适配器及Python/SQLite事务计数服务，不是只测本地字典。一个固定获批配额周期，未测试窗口自动刷新、Redis/生产限流服务集群、丢回复重放计费或完整Istio下发。身份由固定可信教学路由给定，不验证用户认证，不能让未经认证的客户端自选租户/用户绕过配额。描述符兼容只对批准两schema，同身份映射不等于任意策略合并；拒绝未知字段，实例共享同账本且不清零。不接外部集群，不构建镜像。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 解释过滤链、资源与协议的作用范围
交付专用请求矩阵和实际目标证据
明确版本、资源与失败策略

test_files.checks/check.py:
import concurrent.futures,copy,http.server,json,os,pathlib,sqlite3,subprocess,sys,tempfile,threading,time
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path("checks").resolve()))
from envoy_native import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm
print("NATIVE_LINUX_READY",flush=True)
import task
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="envoy-rls-schema-") as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);dbpath=root/"quota.sqlite"
 with sqlite3.connect(dbpath) as db:db.execute("CREATE TABLE quota(tenant TEXT,subject TEXT,used INTEGER,PRIMARY KEY(tenant,subject))")
 observations=[];lock=threading.Lock()
 class Counter(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
  def log_message(self,*args):pass
  def do_POST(self):
   payload=json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])))
   try:
    assert len(payload["descriptors"])==1
    print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: canonicalize actual Envoy gRPC descriptor",flush=True)
    tenant,user=task.canonicalize(payload["domain"],payload["descriptors"][0])
    assert isinstance(tenant,str) and isinstance(user,str) and 0<len(tenant)<64 and 0<len(user)<64
    with sqlite3.connect(dbpath,timeout=2,isolation_level=None) as db:
     db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE");old=db.execute("SELECT used FROM quota WHERE tenant=? AND subject=?",(tenant,user)).fetchone()
     used=0 if old is None else old[0]
     if used>=2:code=2
     else:
      db.execute("INSERT INTO quota VALUES(?,?,1) ON CONFLICT(tenant,subject) DO UPDATE SET used=used+1",(tenant,user));code=1
     db.execute("COMMIT")
    raw=json.dumps(dict(code=code)).encode();status=200
    with lock:observations.append(dict(tenant=tenant,user=user,code=code,entries=payload["descriptors"][0]))
   except Exception:raw=b'{"error":"descriptor rejected"}';status=400
   self.send_response(status);self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(raw)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(raw)
 server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),Counter);server.daemon_threads=True
 thread=threading.Thread(target=lambda:server.serve_forever(poll_interval=.02),daemon=True);thread.start()
 process=None;log=None
 try:
  key=root/"rls.key";cert=root/"rls.crt"
  r=subprocess.run(["openssl","req","-x509","-newkey","rsa:2048","-nodes","-days","1","-keyout",str(key),"-out",str(cert),"-subj","/CN=rls.test","-addext","subjectAltName=DNS:rls.test"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5);assert r.returncode==0
  env=dict(os.environ,GO111MODULE="off",CGO_ENABLED="0",GOMAXPROCS="2",GOMEMLIMIT="384MiB",GOCACHE=str(root/"cache"))
  binary=root/"rls";build=subprocess.run(["go","build","-o",str(binary),"checks/rls.go"],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
  assert build.returncode==0,build.stderr[-2000:]
  print("NATIVE_GO_RLS_V3_ADAPTER_COMPILED",flush=True)
  log=(root/"rls.log").open("wb")
  process=subprocess.Popen([str(binary),str(cert),str(key),"http://127.0.0.1:"+str(server.server_port)+"/quota"],stdout=log,stderr=log)
  deadline=time.monotonic()+4
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   lines=(root/"rls.log").read_text().splitlines()
   if lines and lines[0].startswith("READY "):rls_port=int(lines[0].split()[1]);break
   assert process.poll() is None;time.sleep(.02)
  else:raise AssertionError("private RLS not ready")
  with Upstream() as upstream:
   base=bootstrap(upstream.port);cluster=copy.deepcopy(base["static_resources"]["clusters"][0]);cluster["name"]="rls"
   cluster["load_assignment"]["cluster_name"]="rls";cluster["load_assignment"]["endpoints"][0]["lb_endpoints"][0]["endpoint"]["address"]["socket_address"]["port_value"]=rls_port
   cluster["http2_protocol_options"]={}
   cluster["transport_socket"]={"name":"envoy.transport_sockets.tls","typed_config":{"@type":"type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.transport_sockets.tls.v3.UpstreamTlsContext",
    "sni":"rls.test","common_tls_context":{"alpn_protocols":["h2"],"validation_context":{"trusted_ca":{"filename":str(cert)},
     "match_typed_subject_alt_names":[{"san_type":"DNS","matcher":{"exact":"rls.test"}}]}}}}
   base["static_resources"]["clusters"].append(cluster)
   hcm(base)["http_filters"].insert(0,{"name":"envoy.filters.http.ratelimit","typed_config":{"@type":"type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.ratelimit.v3.RateLimit",
    "domain":"opsforge","timeout":"1s","failure_mode_deny":True,"status_on_error":{"code":"ServiceUnavailable"},
    "rate_limit_service":{"grpc_service":{"envoy_grpc":{"cluster_name":"rls"}},"transport_api_version":"V3"}}})
   routes=[]
   for schema in ["old","new"]:
    for tenant,user in [("A","alice"),("A","bob"),("B","alice"),("A","charlie")]:
     entries=[("tenant",tenant),("user",user)] if schema=="old" else [("subject",user),("tenant_id",tenant)]
     actions=[{"generic_key":{"descriptor_key":name,"descriptor_value":value}} for name,value in entries]
     routes.append({"match":{"path":"/"+schema+"/"+tenant+"/"+user},"route":{"cluster":"service","rate_limits":[{"actions":actions}]}})
   routes.append({"match":{"path":"/unknown"},"route":{"cluster":"service","rate_limits":[{"actions":[{"generic_key":{"descriptor_key":"schema_v3","descriptor_value":"unknown"}}]}]}})
   routes.append({"match":{"path":"/health"},"direct_response":{"status":200,"body":{"inline_string":"ready"}}})
   hcm(base)["route_config"]["virtual_hosts"][0]["routes"]=routes
   with Envoy(base) as old,Envoy(base) as new:
    assert old.request("/old/A/alice")[0]==200
    assert new.request("/new/A/alice")[0]==200
    before=len(upstream.requests);assert old.request("/old/A/alice")[0]==429 and len(upstream.requests)==before,"descriptor rename reset quota"
    assert new.request("/new/B/alice")[0]==200,"tenant scope collapsed across descriptor migration"
    assert old.request("/old/A/bob")[0]==new.request("/new/A/bob")[0]==200
    assert new.request("/new/A/bob")[0]==429
    def hit(n):return (old if n%2==0 else new).request(("/old/" if n%2==0 else "/new/")+"A/charlie")[0]
    before=len(upstream.requests)
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as pool:statuses=list(pool.map(hit,range(6)))
    assert sorted(statuses)==[200,200,429,429,429,429] and len(upstream.requests)==before+2
    with sqlite3.connect(dbpath) as db:rows=db.execute("SELECT tenant,subject,used FROM quota ORDER BY tenant,subject").fetchall()
    assert rows==[("A","alice",2),("A","bob",2),("A","charlie",2),("B","alice",1)]
    before=len(upstream.requests);assert old.request("/unknown")[0]==503 and len(upstream.requests)==before
    assert old.request("/health")[:2]==(200,b"ready")
    assert old.request("/old/A/alice")[0]==new.request("/new/A/alice")[0]==429
   wire=[json.loads(line[9:]) for line in (root/"rls.log").read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith("RLS_WIRE ")]
   assert wire and all(row["protocol"]=="HTTP/2.0" and row["domain"]=="opsforge" for row in wire)
   schemas={tuple(sorted(entry["key"] for entry in row["descriptors"][0])) for row in wire}
   assert schemas=={("tenant","user"),("subject","tenant_id")}
   for domain,entries in [("other",[]),("opsforge",[]),("opsforge",[{"key":"tenant","value":"A"},{"key":"tenant","value":"B"}])]:
    try:task.canonicalize(domain,entries)
    except ValueError:pass
    else:raise AssertionError("unknown descriptor accepted")
   print("NATIVE_TWO_ENVOYS_REAL_RLS_V3_H2_SHARED_QUOTA_SCHEMA_OVERLAP_TENANT_SCOPE_CONCURRENT_ATOMIC_BUDGET "+json.dumps(dict(rows=rows,concurrent_statuses=statuses,wire_requests=len(wire))),flush=True)
 finally:
  if process is not None:
   if process.poll() is None:process.terminate()
   try:process.wait(timeout=3)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait(timeout=2)
  if log:log.close()
  server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join(2)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
